name: Taqueria Las Palmas
tagline: Barbacoa, fajita tacos and big breakfast burritos on 8th Street.
about: Taqueria Las Palmas at 736 8th St in Hempstead serves barbacoa, fajita tacos and massive breakfast burritos from 7 in the morning.
